title: Implement Stack Using Queues
description: Implement a last-in-first-out (LIFO) stack using only two queues. The implemented stack should support all operations of a normal stack (push, pop, top, and empty).

steps.note: Push 2 into the queue. Queue is [1, 2].
Start loop to rotate elements. Move 1 to back.
Shift 1 and push to back. Queue becomes [2, 1].
